chose: guard persistRecipeDraft's enqueue on db.isTransaction; caller enqueues post-commit when it owns the transaction
because: batch-import's commitImport hands persistRecipeDraft its own open trx, so an unconditional enqueue fired before that trx committed and read a not-yet-existing recipe; only the trx owner knows when its own commit lands, so the enqueue moved to runCommitImportChunk's post-commit pass, mirroring the existing hero-image post-commit pass
